# M0.2 residual orchestration remediation — focused Skeptic re-review v1

**Verdict: PARTIALLY REMEDIATED; MOCK_ONLY ENGINE NOT YET ACCEPTABLE.** M02-SK-01 and M02-SK-03 are CLOSED. M02-SK-02, M02-SK-05 and M02-SK-07 are PARTIALLY_REMEDIATED. M02-SK-04 and M02-SK-06 remain CLOSED without regression. Twenty-one independent v4 probes preserve four residual bypass classes, one new MEDIUM receipt-integrity finding and one LOW owner-test evidence finding. No BLOCKER or external-effect path exists because the engine remains `MOCK_ONLY`.

This review consumed `H-M0-031.v1` and Director completion `H-M0-030.v3` at synchronized base `27bd30a71a39f414d1cf3dcc9e515961c731f752`, then claimed at `6932e8e`. ## Finding dispositions

### M02-SK-01 — CLOSED

Current integer attempt 1 works in a pre-completion authoritative fixture. `true`, `false`, `"1"`, `1.0`, zero, negatives, 2147483648 and a much larger integer deny. Python uses exact `type(...) is int`; task/claim/generation schemas impose 1..2147483647. Boolean generation also fails schema validation. No directly decision-critical bool-as-int bypass remains.

### M02-SK-02 — PARTIALLY_REMEDIATED

The real H-M0-030 task now denies because v3 supersedes completed/yielded claim v2, even though the scheduler still says ACTIVE. In a synthetic pre-completion fixture v2 dispatches and adding v3 immediately denies. Wrong attempt/role/status/handoff claim fields deny.

Residual defect: `_current_handoff` validates only exact path existence, `CLAIMED` status and absence of a newer file sharing the record ID. It does not schema-validate the handoff or bind its assignment to task ID, attempt or owner. A minimal, fresh but unrelated `H-M0-099.v1` claim can be referenced by the task and scheduler claim and produces `DISPATCH`.

### M02-SK-03 — CLOSED

Discovery covers conforming `reports/stops/STOP-*.v*.json` records. Added or removed records invalidate the inventory immediately. An indexed additional OPEN STOP with unknown applicability denies. Malformed records, duplicate logical heads and altered records deny. A resolved additional STOP is accepted; an older OPEN version superseded by a valid resolved head is accepted. The actual STOP remains untouched.

Local deletion plus simultaneous scheduler rewrite is still possible to a hostile writer, but that is the documented authenticated append-only FUTURE_GATE rather than a mock-only discovery defect.

### M02-SK-05 — PARTIALLY_REMEDIATED

Nonexistent, incomplete, blocked, self, two-node and transitive-cycle dependencies deny. Caller `completed` input denies and `completed_tasks` IDs no longer authorize anything. Dependencies resolve through repository task paths and are recursively checked.

Residual defects: dependency task records have no version identity/current-head resolution, so scheduler state can point to completed v1 while a blocked v2 exists and dispatch. `completion_evidence` is an untyped nonempty string array; `"human says complete"` and an unrelated attempt 999 manufacture synthetic completion. Authenticated operational evidence remains FUTURE_GATE, but the current contract still promised version-bound, typed synthetic completion and does not supply it.

### M02-SK-07 — PARTIALLY_REMEDIATED

The authoritative `C-REPOSITORY-READ` record is unique, reviewed, trusted, approved, non-revoked, non-executable, network/credential/dependency-free, role-compatible and permission-bound. Missing, unknown, ambiguous, unsafe-flagged and prohibited `semantic_types` capabilities deny. Caller metadata cannot override an unsafe repository record.

Residual defect: the legacy `capabilities` and extra `permissions` arrays remain unconstrained and unexamined. A record with safe `semantic_types: [REPOSITORY_READ]` but `capabilities: [PLUGIN_INSTALL, MCP, LIVE, CAPITAL_MUTATION]` and extra `EXTERNAL_EXECUTION` permission dispatches. Both semantic layers are not coherent.

## Decision receipts — new M02-SK-08 (MEDIUM)

Project/STOP hashes, generation/writer state and attempt affect a successful decision ID. Repeated identical decisions are stable, and different denial reasons produce different denial IDs. The claimed content binding is incomplete:

- safe task operation changes retain the same dispatch ID;
- capability content changes retain the same ID;
- handoff assignment content changes retain the same ID;
- dependency completion-evidence changes retain the same ID;
- different denied task IDs/attempts with the same reason receive the same denial ID.

Receipts therefore do not bind canonical task, capability, handoff, dependency, denial subject or complete local state. Content binding still would not equal authentication. Authenticated sequencing remains FUTURE_GATE, but the implemented local content-binding claim requires remediation now.

## Owner validation evidence — new M02-SK-09 (LOW)

After v3 completion, `tests/test_orchestration.py` runs 5 methods with 3 passes and 2 failures because both positive tests still expect the real completed claim to dispatch. Production denial is correct. `H-M0-030.v3` and the Director results artifact state that the Director orchestration suite passed, which was true only before publishing the superseding completion handoff. The positive tests must use a safe pre-completion fixture and assert the checked-in completed task denies.

## Accepted regressions and positive behavior

M02-SK-04 remains CLOSED: wrong remote, copied checkout and unreachable history deny. M02-SK-06 remains CLOSED: completion, prose approval and rejection calls raise the FUTURE_GATE error.

A correctly formed, currently claimed, dependency-free, capability-safe synthetic task under exact M0.2 state reaches `DISPATCH` with no effect. Adding the legitimate completion handoff makes the same claim non-dispatchable.

No additional pre-executor gate is identified beyond completing local receipt content binding and the three partial current findings.

`STOP-M0-001` remains OPEN; M0 blocked; M1 and Scout unreleased; executor `MOCK_ONLY`; conceptual capital USD 50; deployable/reserved USD 0; live `LOCKED`; kill `ENGAGED`. No ingestion, Research, Quant, paper/live, plugin/skill, capability, MCP, credential or external action occurred.

Director has sufficient evidence to schedule only `H-M0-032.v1`. The decision engine is not acceptable yet, and the FUTURE_GATE orchestration milestone must not begin.
